value.rationale: TARGET-route rigorous disproof of an admitted motivated question: labelled LG mutation data is not a Hamiltonian-isotopy invariant on Bl_2 CP^2. perplexity_final_check.rationale: Terminal check returned 20 results with 5 base overlaps, adding 15 incremental URLs. I opened and body-inspected every plausibly covering candidate: the PT foundation PDF, the Albers cluster-character paper (closest lead: general LG-seed non-involutivity formula), the Hicks deposited paper, Vianna 1602.03356, both Vianna slide decks, the Cheung-Vianna cluster-compactification paper, the Venugopalan-Woodward tropical potential paper, plus full-text screens of the Chanda higher-projective, Casals ellipsoid-staircase, Brendel local-exotic-tori, and AGT-cobordism bodies (different objects: higher projective spaces, CP1xCP1 staircases, R6, general cobordisms). Nothing states or implies the submitted headline: no source computes the Bl2 (2,2) reverse-word pair (W2,V2), forms the 2-vs-1 joint invariant, or pairs it with Lemma 4.19 isotopy to disprove labelled faithfulness. Albers states non-involutivity only as a general algebraic identity without the Bl2 instantiation, isotopy premise, or inequivalence proof, so it does not cover the claim. Useful recall therefore duplicated base providers plus near-miss leads; no decisive prior found and originality PASS is preserved with no unresolved candidates.
